maya: Quick idea 1 'Spark Sprint' 1 a micro-launch focused on 5 tiny refapps + one-hour live micro-benchmark webinar. Goal: dev signups, repo stars, short-form videos. Who owns launch post, benchmark brief, webinar landing, and inbound routing?
sam: I can write the launch post + 3-tweet thread. Target Tue 5/3. Will share draft Mon EOD.
jordan: I'll do the micro-benchmark brief. Thinking: 3 payloads (chat, summarization, embed) across 32/128 tokens, highlight latency & token cost. Need quick perf from eng-ml.
emily: Webinar ops: 45min demo (3 demos @10m each) + 15 Q&A. I'll own slides, landing, and follow-up email. Wed 5/11 evening US?
chris: HubSpot routing: hidden field spark_sprint=true, tag 'spark-2026', segment dev vs enterprise. Immediate email -> quickstart, 48h nurture -> benchmark PDF gated.
zara: Eng-ML will provide sample numbers; looping in now.
design: Need 2 hero comps: short-code and motion micro-video (15s).
maya: Timeline: launch post 5/3, bench 5/6, webinar 5/11. Owners: sam/jordan/emily/chris. Sync 11am PST tomorrow.
sam: Hero blurb draft: "Ship tiny refapps in minutes. See how micro-benchmarks change your cost/latency tradeoffs."
emily: I'll create Zoom event + registration. Will also prepare a 1-click deploy repo button for each refapp.
chris: I'll prototype the HubSpot form and share the JSON.
maya: Great. Keep messages tight in #marketing-drafts. 15min sync tomorrow. :rocket:
